notes.title: King and Big Sheep! The new version is available!
notes.content:
[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] 10 new challenging hidden levels are waiting for you.
[/list]

[h1]Experience Optimized[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added windowed mode and adjustable resolution.
[*] Save file information will now display completion percentage.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Chess pieces will now prioritize and attack opponents in a certain order, rather than attacking randomly.
[*] Fixed save file bugs for some players opening a saved file will now repair the issue.
[*] When controlling two adjacent piglets, they can now move in sync.
[/list]

Since the release of Piggy Gambit on Steam Workshop, the community has created numerous high-quality levels for everyone to experience. If you've completed the game but are still hungry for more, don't miss out.

Additionally, Piggy Gambit will also participate in the Steam Strategy Fest. We invite everyone of you to enjoy the game and leave your feedback!

notes.title: Piggy Gambit Summer Sale Begins! (with the Workshop Guide)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

During the ongoing Steam Summer Sale, Piggy Gambit is also offering a 20% discount. If you missed the game's release discount, this is a great opportunity for you to get it!

In addition, we have recently launched the Steam Workshop, which allows players to create your own levels and share them with the community for others to play. Here is the SOP:

[olist]
[*] First, you need to complete the main levels to unlock another character.
[*] The levels following the main levels are custom levels, and players can enter and edit them with the new character.
[*] After editing the level, press the Esc key to see the option to upload the level to the Workshop.
[*] Once the upload is complete, go to the right side of your Steam profile and find "Workshop Items" to see the level you uploaded.
[*] Click on your levels and set its visibility to "Public", and then other players can see your levels in the Workshop.
[/olist]

Currently, there are already some player-created levels available for everyone to subscribe and experience in the Workshop. If you have any questions about using it, please feel free to leave a comment!

notes.title: Version 1.0.18
notes.content:
1. Levels that have been played will be marked as played.
2. Fixed the bug of restarting and settling Creative Workshop levels
3. Fixed the save time display issue caused by an abnormal exit.

notes.title: Creative Workshop is now available！ 1.0.17
notes.content:
[h1]Update content[/h1]
1. The creative workshop has been added！！！！！！
2. In Chapter 5, the current moved ground will no longer be attacked, but the just moved ground will be attacked immediately
3. Fixed several bugs.

[h1]Creative Workshop Instructions[/h1]
Creation: After clearing the level, you can choose to upload to the Creative Workshop when saving in the editor.
Play Workshop Levels: Please subscribe to the levels in Steam, and then play in the subscribed levels in the main interface.
The current Creative Workshop feature is still quite simple, and will be updated in the future according to everyone's needs.

notes.title: Piggy Gambit is Available Now！
notes.content:
Hi players! Thank you for your continued support. Piggy Gambit is finally released today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40922375/b755ef4f4ee275e9b9e2ee9a7bdb8f41fd7c6c80.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340920/

This is a casual puzzle game developed by TofuSoup, integrating various gameplay elements such as chess and push box. Follow our protagonist "Oink 3" on a journey to solve numerous puzzles while searching for the meaning of life.

If you have any problems during the game, want to communicate with us, or just want to share the levels you made, feel free to join our[url=https://discord.gg/45unQMk6xP] Discord Channel[/url].

notes.title: Piggy Gambit DEMO is out now!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We've just released the first open free demo of Piggy Gambit for the upcoming Steam Next Fest!

The demo consists of the 13 selected levels from the full game to show how the core gameplay works, but it should give you a taste of what the full game is like. And don't forget to wishlist it if you like it: 
   
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340920/
   
Piggy Gambit is a game developed by a solo indie studio, and it harmoniously combines the elements of chess, box puzzles, and flow control into a coherent puzzle game about a piggy searching for the meaning of his life. We hope that you can enjoy it and feel free to let us know what you think of it, welcome to join the discord: [url=https://discord.gg/5gBu6VnqnW]https://discord.gg/5gBu6VnqnW[/url]

And please don't forget to check the brand-newdemos of the games published by indienova during this Steam Next Fest: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indienova/list/98354
